import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between the features colored by species
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data, hue="species", palette="Set1", markers=["o", "s", "D"])

# Set titles and labels on the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Flower Species Classification", y=1.02)
pairplot.set(xlabel="Measurements", ylabel="Measurements")

# Save the figure as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
